agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py's _process_identifierlist: an erroneous 'self.wrap_after > 0' guard had been added around the per-identifier newline-insertion loop for plain (non-VALUES) identifier lists, so with the default wrap_after=0 no wrapping ever occurred (e.g. 'select foo, bar' stayed on one line instead of becoming 'select foo,\n  bar'). Removed that guard from the loop while keeping the legitimate wrap_after>0 guard on the separate _last_func/adjusted_offset branch (the 'wrap function params when wrap_after is set' feature), which must remain gated. Verified with manual checks: default reindent of multi-column SELECT/comma_first now wraps one identifier per line again; wrap_after with long lines still wraps appropriately; function-arg lists and INSERT...VALUES formatting remain sensible. This should restore the 15 failing 'format reindent: identifier list*' checks without breaking other reindent behavior.
